description: This file defines models and classes related to 'Analytic Plans' in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for analytic plans, plan lines, plan instances, and their integration with invoices, journals, and sale orders.

classes.name: one2many_mod2
classes.description: Custom one2many field with specialized get method for analytic plans

classes.name: account_analytic_plan
classes.description: Model representing analytic plans with plan lines

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_line
classes.description: Model representing individual lines within an analytic plan

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_instance
classes.description: Model representing instances of analytic plans, including methods for copying, naming, and view customization

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_instance_line
classes.description: Model representing individual analytic account lines within an instance

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Extension of account.journal to include a plan_id

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice.line to include analytics_id

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Extension of account.move.line to include analytics_id and analytic line creation logic

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice to handle analytic lines and references

classes.name: analytic_default
classes.description: Extension of account.analytic.default to include analytics_id

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extension of sale.order.line to set analytic accounts on invoice creation

methods.name: get
methods.description: Custom get method for one2many_mod2 to retrieve related analytic plan lines based on context

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of an analytic plan instance, resetting account line IDs

methods.name: _default_journal
methods.description: Returns default journal's analytic_journal_id if available

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display name for analytic plan instances, including code if available

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches for analytic plan instances by code or name

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Generates dynamic view architecture for analytic plan instances based on context

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new analytic plan instance, with validation for duplicate names and code

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates an analytic plan instance, copying if plan_id is removed

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display name for analytic plan instances

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches for analytic plan instances by code or name
